sequence.purpose: feature branch; owner must finish latest-head review

before_each_merge: resolve live head and base; prior review of another head is stale
inspect diff and complete original acceptance criteria
verify no private runtime or raw evidence is in outgoing history
require matching review, QA and applicable CI; missing checks remain gaps
obtain human merge approval for the exact head
after_each_merge: record actual merge commit and retained delivery ancestry
run applicable checks on integrated main
retarget remaining PRs only after inspecting their resulting diff
resolve conflicts only in an owned task worktree; new head requires new checks
unlock dependents only after integrated checks pass
legacy_work: Original dirty work and old delivery commits remain local. Import only an explicitly reviewed task diff; never bulk-import legacy history.
unresolved: native Multica PR event integration is replaced by explicit CLI polling in PIT-48; no native card claim
